description: This file defines the SeoUrl class within the Opencart admin model for managing SEO URLs, including methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving SEO URL records from the database.
external_files: database connection and query functions (implied by $this->db)

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Model class for managing SEO URL records in the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: addSeoUrl
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO URL record into the database with specified parameters.

methods.name: editSeoUrl
methods.description: Updates an existing SEO URL record identified by seo_url_id.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrl
methods.description: Deletes an SEO URL record by its ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Deletes SEO URL records matching a specific key and value, optionally filtered by store and language.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record by its ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record matching a key and value, optionally filtered by store and language.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record by its keyword, store ID, and optional language ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrls
methods.description: Retrieves multiple SEO URL records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves SEO URL data grouped by store and language for a given key and value.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves all SEO URL records for a specific store.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all SEO URL records for a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalSeoUrls
methods.description: Returns the total count of SEO URL records, with optional filters.
